steps: From the repo root: GODOT=/Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot STRATEGIES='decent always_expand' SEEDS='1 2 3 4 5' TAG=vis LIMIT=150 qa/bots/run_batch.sh <out_dir>. Fast clock, default choice. Compare results_*.jsonl per seed.
expected: always_expand is a distinct counter-strategy (no reserve, buys whenever cash allows). Either it loses or wins for a different reason than decent, so the strategy comparison means something.
actual: always_expand wins on all 5 seeds and matches decent exactly on every seed: same final_cash (9498, 8826, 8538, 9730, 8773), same win cycle (26, 26, 25, 26, 26), same 4 ships, same 4 routes, same ship_buys. Decent's reserve (1000 cr) and lane cap never change the outcome in this build. Sloppy and never_expand lose at cycle 30 on all seeds. Bot-side or balance question: needs a check of whether decent is really limited, not a game crash.
